summary_statistics.info: 2293 rows, 19 columns. Dtypes: object (firm_id), float32 (18 numeric columns). Non-null counts: most columns complete except fixedfee/hourlyrate/has_fixed_fee/total_price (n=543) and emergency/emergency_A (n=728).

original_datasets.notes: Key variables for analyses: complaints_2008 (count outcome), first_A (A/number name indicator), firm_age, emp_size (to be log-transformed), num_names_2008, multiple_names, chicago, ad_spending, on_google. Some pricing-related fields are sparse.

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Center continuous predictors, effect-code binary factors, log-transform employee size, then fit Poisson GLMs with robust SEs and a Negative Binomial model predicting complaints_2008 from first_A and controls.
preprocessing_steps: Effect-code binary predictors (first_A, multiple_names, chicago, on_google) as -0.5/0.5.

key_choices.model_choice: Poisson GLM with HC0 robust SEs; Negative Binomial (NB2) with same specification as full-control Poisson.
key_choices.inference_rule: p-value on first_A coefficient; HC0 robust SE; incident rate ratio (IRR) and 95% CI.

codebase.notes: R Markdown analyses were translated to Python per run policy. All IO paths use /app/data. The Negative Binomial model uses statsmodels.discrete NegativeBinomial (NB2). Robust covariance is HC0 for Poisson GLMs.
